articles.title: From Hour-Long Drips to a One-Minute Jab: How a New Cancer Shot Is Freeing Up Patients' Lives
articles.summary: A new injectable form of the immunotherapy Keytruda slashes treatment time from over an hour to just one minute. 86-year-old Shirley Xerxes says it gives her more time for gardening. About 14,000 NHS patients in England could benefit.

articles.title: RAVEN AI Uncovers 118 New Planets, Including Ultra-Short Orbits and Worlds in the 'Neptunian Desert'
articles.summary: University of Warwick astronomers used the RAVEN AI pipeline to confirm 118 new exoplanets from NASA TESS data. Some orbit in under 24 hours; others lie in the mysterious Neptunian desert. The study also precisely measured how common close-in planets are.

articles.title: A Flaw in Time Itself? Quantum Collapse Models Hint at a Fundamental Limit to Clock Precision
articles.summary: Physicists exploring quantum collapse models linked to gravity have calculated that time may have an inherent, extremely tiny uncertainty. This sets a fundamental limit on clock precision, but it's far too small to affect even the best atomic clocks.
